crossRefs.note: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.

translations.web: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.
translations.bsb: Join five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another. Then fold the sixth curtain over double at the front of the tent.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
translations.asv: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.
